name: Accept the 16 概述/Overview collisions as manual — generator collision-skips them + emits a per-run manual-retrofit candidate list; 49 clean pairs retrofit automatically

generatorDiffs.lineRange: 362-364 (insert between extractPairPlan close and the SkeletonInsertion interface)
generatorDiffs.rationale: F3's whole premise is detection-then-skip. The collision is precisely `zhHeadings[i]==='概述' (=== ZH_HEADINGS.summary) && enHeadings[i]==='Overview'` (the ZH renders EN's `## Overview` as `## 概述`, the SAME word F3's ZH Summary uses). The recon verified this is a perfect 0-discrepancy match on exactly 16 packages and 0/65 already carry `## Summary`, so the trigger is precisely bounded: it never misfires on the 49 clean pairs (those either have no ZH 概述 at all, or a 概述 paired with EN `## Summary` — en==='Summary'≠'Overview' → false). It also correctly does NOT flag an already-F1-retrofitted pair (ZH `## Overview`+`## 概述`: at the Summary slot en==='Summary'→false; at the Overview slot zh==='Overview'≠'概述'→false). The helper is a pure read (no mutation) so it cannot itself perturb the pairing signature. Placement after extractPairPlan keeps PairPlan consumers together.

returning [] makes planRetrofits' `retrofits.push(...retrofitPair(enFile))` push nothing for the 16, so they are absent from retrofits → absent from the drift filter → the `--check` gate neither writes nor reports them (the documented blind spot the recon F3 prescribes). The pair is skipped BEFORE insertFrontmatter, so the 16 are never mutated by the generator (idempotent no-op on them, stable across re-runs). The console.warn names each skipped enFile — together the 16 warns ARE the manual-retrofit candidate list, emitted on every run (gen + --check), reminding the operator the 16 are outstanding. Gated on `hasZh &&` because the collision is a ZH-side condition (no ZH sibling ⇒ no 概述 to collide); mirrors the existing divergence-check's `hasZh &&` pattern. Placed AFTER the divergence throw so positional-pair integrity is guaranteed before collision-detect.

generatorDiffs.rationale: The old note said the bug 'blocks wiring' and framed the fix as an open design decision needing a grilling call. After F3 lands, the generator's own behavior is settled (skip + emit), so the note must reflect the new state: the 49 are auto-handled, the 16 are skipped-to-manual, the --check gate has a blind spot, and doc-standard stays 2-RED until the manual pass. Leaving the stale 'blocks wiring / needs grilling' note would mislead the next operator into thinking the generator is still unsafe to wire. The added 'does NOT prevent recurrence' line records F3's known limitation honestly so a future package with the same shape is expected to be skipped, not a surprise.

pairingImpact: 49 auto-green, 16 manual (pre-existing green preserved, no regressions). THE 49 CLEAN PAIRS (no 概述/Overview collision): the generator's insertSkeleton path is UNCHANGED for them — it writes frontmatter + `## Summary`/`## Table of Contents`/`## Dev Note` on EN and `## 概述`/`## 目录`/`## 开发备注` on ZH, threads EN-slug `<a id>` anchors before existing ZH H2s. Both sides reach symmetric H2 counts (6/6 for the 49 that carry an existing `## Overview`/`## 概述`-as-Summary... — wait, the 49 do NOT have the collision, so their ZH 概述 (if any) is paired with EN `## Summary` or absent; the generator inserts Summary on both sides symmetrically → matching counts + matching English-slug link targets → verify-translation-pairing green on all 49). The 49 were at baseline (the bug-run was reverted), and the clean insertion keeps them green (no regression). THE 16 COLLISION PAIRS: the generator returns [] → writes NOTHING to them. They stay at their pre-existing green pairing state (the 130-file bug-run was reverted per the decision-doc, restoring the 16 to green; the generator now skips them so they are never mutated). The 16 console.warn lines name them as manual-retrofit candidates. They REMAIN pairing-green throughout (skipped = untouched = no pairing change) BUT they still LACK frontmatter + Summary/TOC/Dev Note → doc-standard.spec.ts stays 2-RED on their account until the manual pass. AFTER THE MANUAL 16-PASS (F1-logic per file, recon-recommended: add frontmatter, rename ZH `## 概述`→`## Overview`, insert Summary `## 概述`, rebuild TOC, thread `<a id>` anchors, mirror EN): the 16 reach symmetric 6/6 H2 (Summary+TOC+Overview+ModelExp+KnownLimitations+DevNote) with identical link-target sequences → pairing green AND doc-standard 12/12. Authored-heading-text change by the GENERATOR: NONE (F3 skips the 16; the 49 get only NEW TODO-placeholder Summary/TOC/DevNote + anchors — no existing heading is renamed by the generator). Authored-text change happens only in the MANUAL 16-pass (ZH `## 概述`(Overview) → `## Overview` per-file), which is out of the generator's scope. The pairing signature (translation-pairing.ts:404 translationStructureSignature pushes node.depth only, never text) is invisible to that rename anyway.
signatureSafe: Generator idempotency + --check gate semantics preserved. IDEMPOTENCY: (a) the 49 clean pairs get frontmatter on first run → planRetrofits' `if (hasFrontmatter(currentEn)) continue` guard (line 538) skips them on re-run → '0 stale' on second run. (b) insertSkeleton's hasSummary/hasToc/hasDevNote checks (lines 394-396) are UNCHANGED → a pair already carrying Summary 概述/目录/开发备注 is not re-inserted (idempotent within the 49). (c) the 16 collision pairs are NEVER written by the generator (return [] before insertFrontmatter) → they are a stable no-op on every run; the warn fires but no bytes change. --CHECK GATE: drift = retrofits.filter(current!==next). Because the 16 return [] they are absent from retrofits → absent from drift → --check never reports them as stale (the documented blind spot the recon F3 prescribes). For the 49, --check semantics are byte-identical to the pre-F3 generator: first run → 49 stale → exit 1 with the file list; steady state (post-write) → 0 stale → exit 0. The collision-detect is a pure read gated on `hasZh &&` and placed after the divergence throw (positional-pair integrity guaranteed first), so it cannot itself break pairing — it only decides skip-vs-proceed. The skip returns [] which planRetrofits' spread handles cleanly (pushes nothing). doc-standard.spec.ts (scans ALL depth-4 files, not just generator targets) is the backstop that catches the 16's missing frontmatter/headings — so the blind spot is covered by a heavier gate, not unmonitored. No NEW regressions possible on the 49 (their insertSkeleton path is unchanged). The F3 skip does not touch the EN-side logic at all, so the EN soundness the decision-doc established (49/65 clean) is fully preserved.

risk: (1) Does NOT prevent recurrence: every FUTURE package with the 概述/Overview collision shape is skipped + emitted as a manual candidate; the generator never learns F1, so each new collision package needs manual handling again. Only doc-standard.spec.ts (the heavier spec) catches the drift, not the quick --check gate. (2) 16-file manual pass (32 files: 16 EN + 16 ZH) is tedious and error-prone: heading rename + Summary insertion + TOC rebuild + anchor threading + frontmatter + per-pair sidecar re-record, with NO idempotent re-run protection — a second `pnpm run gen-package-readme-skeleton` skips the 16 (collision still matches), so it cannot self-heal a manual mistake; the manual edits must be right the first time, verified per-pair by `verify-translation-pairing --write`. (3) --check gate blind spot: the 16 are skipped, not enforced; drift on the 16 AFTER manual retrofit (e.g., someone edits a retrofitted ZH file and breaks the TOC) is only caught by doc-standard.spec.ts, not the quick freshness gate. (4) doc-standard.spec.ts stays 2-RED until the manual 16-pass completes — so the generator can be WIRED (the gate green for the 49) but the 2 RED structure tests only go GREEN after the manual pass; wiring-before-manual is a half-green state. (5) F3 does NOT avoid the F1/F2 design decision: the manual pass must still pick F1-logic (rename ZH 概述→Overview, recon-recommended — preserves Overview as a TOC entry; the 16 ZH docs already render `## Model Experience` and `## Known Limitations and Deferred Work` in English, so `## Overview` is consistent with their own established convention) or F2-logic (rename EN Overview→Summary, loses Overview from TOC) per file. The recon recommends F1 per-file for the manual pass.
